contracts.accessibleNames: Rendered native text, associated labels, aria-label and aria-labelledby are projected without activation
contracts.keyboard: Rendered browser tab-order projection plus native activation and bounded custom key-handler source contracts
contracts.hiddenState: Computed visibility plus hidden, aria-hidden, inert and open-modal leakage are inspected
contracts.passive: No click, focus, submit, event dispatch, network, or storage operation

limitations: DOM order is a deterministic projection, not a claim of exhaustive Narrator certification. Narrator semantic entry and the bounded owner runtime lifecycle evidence are accepted; no further Windows AT action remains.
